name: Data Engineering & Data Quality
description: Orchestration profile for ETL/ELT pipelines, schema migrations, and data quality verification.

tools.name: python3
tools.description: Runtime for executing data quality checks and schema transformations.

tools.name: sqlite3
tools.description: Tool for local SQL query testing and table constraint validation.

tools.name: dbt
tools.description: Optional data modeling and data quality verification tool (if used by the consumer repository).

candidate_checks.description: Verify primary key constraints, NULL ratios, data types, and referential integrity.
Ensure re-running on the same data partition does not produce duplicate records.

expected_evidence: Actual exit codes of the repository-accepted data quality and schema checks
Valid file scope evidence and git diff --check verification
Evidence classification results from Jev (jev-1.13.0) and evaluation from a fresh reviewer
special_risks: Breaking schema drift affecting downstream tables
Record duplication during backfills or timezone mismatches at date partition boundaries (UTC vs local)
Implicit calculation of financial metrics (PnL/funding/risk) in ETL pipelines without activating the quant profile
quant_escalation_required_when: Any data task that computes or transforms PnL, funding, liquidation, margin, leverage, or risk metrics must explicitly select the quant profile and --work-kind quant
